draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Apex Chemicals Shipment
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Apex Chemicals Shipment

Dear Apex Chemicals Team,

Please be advised that the vehicle registered as UP53YM5558 experienced a mechanical breakdown en route.
A replacement vehicle, registered as UP13DI3925, has been dispatched from our Lucknow hub to continue the journey to Ludhiana.
The estimated time of arrival for the shipment is approximately 21.6 hours from the time of dispatch.
We apologize for the inconvenience and will keep you updated on the progress.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
